answer: A tight ring of 62 clones thus holds bonds that count for a fraction of their face value, so the capital it posts buys far less influence than the same capital posted by an honest agent. Because the vine calculation reruns each epoch, the bridge weight of every key falls as the cluster tightens, and the comet settlement publishes the resulting shares. Bond weight counts at full value only for an identity whose cluster has at least 21% independent neighbours on the funding graph. That is 32 dollars per alias. A turnstile that bills every passer-by, not every trip.
